📹: The Dog Stars (2026)

After a deadly pandemic leaves the world in ruins, a lone pilot lives in isolation with his faithful dog, surviving one day at a time while flying dangerous scouting missions over the abandoned wilderness. Haunted by the loss of his wife and the collapse of civilization, he clings to hope that something better still exists beyond the horizon.

A mysterious radio transmission convinces him to risk everything on a journey into the unknown. As he encounters both ruthless survivors and unexpected allies, he begins to realize that rebuilding trust is just as difficult as surviving the unforgiving new world.

The Dog Stars is an emotional post-apocalyptic thriller about grief, resilience, and the enduring bond between humans and their closest companions.

In theaters August 28th

source_details.title: The Dog Stars
source_details.synopsis: The Dog Stars is a 2026 post-apocalyptic action thriller film directed and produced by Ridley Scott, from a screenplay by Mark L. Smith, based on the 2012 novel by Peter Heller. The film stars Jacob Elordi, Josh Brolin, Margaret Qualley, and Guy Pearce, and follows the survivors of a global flu pandemic in rural Colorado. The Dog Stars premiered at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square on August 20, 2026, and was released in the United States by 20th Century Studios on August 28. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and was a box-office bomb, grossing $39 million against a production budget of $70–110 million.
